global_caption: The video contains 8 shots. It is a realistic neutral-toned young male perfume advertisement, progressing from a cold misty forest to a golden sunset cliff. The overall lighting is dominated by natural side and back lighting. Camera movement starts with controlled fluid motion, gradually rising and stabilizing at the end. Entirely in English throughout, maintaining a consistently reserved yet passionate emotional tone.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, wide overhead composition spreading out the misty forest, deep tree trunks forming clear leading lines, foreground mist blurred, midground a young male walking through holding perfume, background layered cool white mist spreading through trees. Morning natural diffuse light gives the entire scene a reserved neutral cool tone. His steps are steady and light, the bottle in his hand reflecting faint cool light in the mist. Low English ", ending tone aligned with subtle Camera performs slow forward push with slight follow, establishing brand worldview and character persona.
shot2: Shot 2 connects to previous shot via hard cut, cutting to side-lit close-up. Composition places a dew-covered wet leaf in foreground focus. Young male's fingertip sweeps across leaf surface from right side of frame. In shallow depth-of-field background, perfume bottle is steadily held in palm, visible condensation on bottle wall clearly lit by side-backlight. Environment remains forest edge, mist not gone but closer to skin and plant surfaces. Action slows down, leaf slightly rebounds after touch, water droplet trembles. Camera performs slight horizontal pan, making texture and material the visual focus.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions from previous shot via action-matched push into extreme close-up. Uses eye-level extreme close-up compressing nozzle, knuckle, and bottle opening to center of frame. Foreground is semi-transparent mist, background completely blurred into cool gray-green. Side-backlight highlights liquid glow during spray moment. Young male's thumb firmly presses nozzle, fine fragrance mist explodes toward camera. Simultaneously, massive overlay text "RAW / CLEAR / FREE" appears, positioned slightly above center, rendered in bold sans-serif font with silver matte metallic texture, edges glowing cold with mist particles bursting outward, occupying most of screen space.
shot4: Shot 4 hard cuts to medium-wide eye-level shot on mountain path. Foreground shows residual fragrance mist blown apart by wind. Midground features young male moving quickly along seaside path. Overall tone remains neutral, daylight beginning to warm slightly. Wind becomes primary dynamic force, clothing, hair, and mist trail in same direction. Fragrance mist forms visible streamer behind him. No Camera uses lateral tracking with slight handheld micro-shake, enhancing sense of movement and spatial transition.
shot5: Shot 5 hard cuts via quick whip pan to low-angle panoramic view of cliff. Young male reaches highest point of cliff, positioned at upper third intersection. Foreground is rough rock surface, background illuminated sea horizon and rolling clouds. Backlight outlines his silhouette with clear bright edge. Image shifts from cool to neutral-warm while maintaining realistic restraint. Camera gently tilts up from low position with slight push-in, elevating character presence within space.
shot6: Shot 6 hard cuts to overhead close-up. Camera looks straight down at rocky shore. Perfume bottle placed centrally on damp rock surface. Sea foam periodically surges in and recedes, white bubbles forming natural ring around bottle. Foreground features water droplets clinging to rock edge, background filled with wave patterns. Lighting remains natural but leans gold-gray. Bottle glass reflects sharp, cool highlights. Physical changes clearly visible: foam approaches and envelops base, retreats leaving moist reflection and salt grain texture. Camera remains stable overhead, only slight descent, emphasizing premium feel and order.
shot7: Shot 7 transitions from previous shot via fade in/out to near-extreme close-up macro shot. Focuses on moment fragrance mist blends with sea fog in air. Side-backlight gives each mist particle clear edge. Only partial hand of young male enters frame, briefly sprays again. Fragrance mist intertwines, spreads, dissipates with sea fog. Subtitle "WOOD SALT WIND" appears slightly below center, using semi-transparent matte silver 3D text, letter spacing widened, accompanied by mist particles dispersing outward then stabilizing. Spray Camera performs extremely slow macro push-in, transforming scent imagery into perceivable visual symbol.
shot8: Shot 8 hard cuts into final frozen frame at sunset cliff. Uses wide eye-level composition. Young male stands slightly left-front, calmly facing sea. Product bottle enlarged in right foreground. Character and product form clear dual protagonist structure. Overall neutral tone wrapped in final layer of golden backlight. Frame nearly static, only wind moves clothing and sea surface sparkles. Full-screen title "NEW EAU DE PARFUM" appears centrally, using massive cold silver bold uppercase letters, vertically centered, horizontally filling screen, edges with faint mist glow, fading slowly from solid to transparent, lingering with product highlights before vanishing. Camera remains locked with barely perceptible slight pull-out, completing brand finalization.
